failedCi.failure: journey.test.ts:182 expected /Coat/ but observed Identity; standalone smoke skipped.

diagnosis: Native Escape closes the modal and restores its invoker before dispatching a queued close event. A deliberate chapter focus between those moments was overridden by the shared close listener; Enter then reopened Accessibility instead of navigating to Coat. Passive event records demonstrate this order.

before.control: The full unchanged journey passed once locally; bounded isolated modal transitions exposed the timing defect.

fix: Ignore obsolete close callbacks when the modal has reopened or a connected outside element holds newer focus. Retain original invoker and returnAction restoration when focus remains in the closed dialog/body or original invoker.
regression: Original three E2E tests and Escape/chapter Enter/Coat assertion retained. Existing journey additionally exercises native close then deliberate focus and native close then reopen before queued event delivery, with no sleeps or timeout changes.
